# npmplus_version (Data Source)

This data source can be used to get the current version of NPMplus.


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "npmplus_version" "version" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `major` (Number) The major version number.
- `minor` (Number) The minor version number.
- `revision` (Number) The revision version number.
- `version` (String) The full version.
